title: TS-2 T-Stack GPU tower rev B: 64 GPUs, 16 per column, chilled-water tracing + Peltier trim
summary: Revision B puts the GPUs in the tower: four columns of 16 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q cards (64 per tower). Each card plugs into a CBP-8 backplane (2 per column, 8-layer Megtron 6, x16 CEM slots wired x8, MCIO 8i to the host switch cards, per-slot hot-swap and 12V-2x6 power), is held by a tail-guide comb, bracket screw rail and hinged hold-down bars, and is cooled by inlet air drawn through a chilled-water tracing coil (dew point + 2 K) and trimmed by a 4-TEC Peltier module on a split copper cold block; the crown turbines evacuate the hot plenum air. Power: 4 CRPS 2000 W per column into the CPD-1 board, straps, 4/0 cables and 14 x 10 mm copper busbars. Four KiCad boards (CBP-8, CPD-1, CCM-1 cooling controller, TCD-1 Peltier driver) each have a RushPCB turnkey package; the harness has a numbered wire list and a PCIe Gen4 loss budget. Parametric build123d CAD (1058 placed parts), 33 dual-unit drawings with DXF cut files, a 12-step illustrated column build, a rolled-up BOM, and a digital twin with 9 acceptance tests (all pass). Nothing has been built or measured.
